BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Neasden, London – popularly called ‘London Mandir’ and ‘Neasden Temple’ </br>Mahant Swami Maharaj had described London Mandir as “Our Home” during the Mandir’s 25th anniversary in 2020; a large sign bearing his handwritten message was ready to welcome him
Thousands of devotees and hundreds of volunteers had started arriving at London Mandir from as early as 3.30am in eager anticipation of Swamishri's arrival

To learn more about this unique devotional welcome, please click here
